label: sufficiently transparent operation
definition: High-risk AI systems must be designed and developed to ensure their operation is sufficiently transparent, enabling deployers to interpret the system's output and use it appropriately.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way as to ensure that their operation is sufficiently transparent to enable deployers to interpret a system's output and use it appropriately

label: instructions for use content
definition: High-risk AI systems must be accompanied by instructions for use containing specific information such as provider identity, system characteristics, limitations, changes, human oversight measures, resource needs, and log collection mechanisms.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be accompanied by instructions for use in an appropriate digital format or otherwise that include concise, complete, correct and clear information that is relevant, accessible and comprehensible to deployers

label: provider identity and contact details
definition: Instructions for use must contain the identity and contact details of the provider and, where applicable, its authorised representative.
source_quote: the identity and the contact details of the provider and, where applicable, of its authorised representative

label: characteristics, capabilities and limitations
definition: Instructions for use must include information on the characteristics, capabilities and limitations of performance of the high-risk AI system.
source_quote: the characteristics, capabilities and limitations of performance of the high-risk AI system

label: intended purpose
definition: Instructions for use must specify the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

label: accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity metrics
definition: Instructions for use must include the level of accuracy, including its metrics, robustness and cybersecurity against which the system has been tested and validated, along with known and foreseeable circumstances impacting these.
source_quote: the level of accuracy, including its metrics, robustness and cybersecurity referred to in Article 15 against which the high-risk AI system has been tested and validated and which can be expected, and any known and foreseeable circumstances that may have an impact on that expected level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity

label: known or foreseeable risk circumstances
definition: Instructions for use must include any known or foreseeable circumstance related to the use of the high-risk AI system that may lead to risks to health, safety, or fundamental rights.
source_quote: any known or foreseeable circumstance, related to the use of the high-risk AI system in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, which may lead to risks to the health and safety or fundamental rights referred to in Article 9(2)

label: capabilities to provide explanatory information
definition: Instructions for use must include, where applicable, the technical capabilities and characteristics of the high-risk AI system to provide information that is relevant to explain its output.
source_quote: where applicable, the technical capabilities and characteristics of the high-risk AI system to provide information that is relevant to explain its output

label: performance regarding specific persons or groups
definition: Instructions for use must include, when appropriate, the system's performance regarding specific persons or groups of persons on which the system is intended to be used.
source_quote: when appropriate, its performance regarding specific persons or groups of persons on which the system is intended to be used

label: input data specifications and training data information
definition: Instructions for use must include, when appropriate, specifications for the input data or other relevant information regarding the training, validation and testing data sets used.
source_quote: when appropriate, specifications for the input data, or any other relevant information in terms of the training, validation and testing data sets used, taking into account the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system

label: information to enable output interpretation
definition: Instructions for use must include, where applicable, information to enable deployers to interpret the output of the high-risk AI system and use it appropriately.
source_quote: where applicable, information to enable deployers to interpret the output of the high-risk AI system and use it appropriately

label: predetermined changes to system and performance
definition: Instructions for use must include the changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance which have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment, if any.
source_quote: the changes to the high-risk AI system and its performance which have been pre-determined by the provider at the moment of the initial conformity assessment, if any

label: human oversight measures
definition: Instructions for use must include the human oversight measures referred to in Article 14, including technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of outputs by deployers.
source_quote: the human oversight measures referred to in Article 14, including the technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of the outputs of the high-risk AI systems by the deployers

label: computational resources, lifetime and maintenance needs
definition: Instructions for use must include the computational and hardware resources needed, the expected lifetime of the high-risk AI system, and any necessary maintenance and care measures to ensure proper functioning.
source_quote: the computational and hardware resources needed, the expected lifetime of the high-risk AI system and any necessary maintenance and care measures, including their frequency, to ensure the proper functioning of that AI system, including as regards software updates

label: mechanisms for log collection and interpretation
definition: Instructions for use must include, where relevant, a description of the mechanisms included within the high-risk AI system that allows deployers to properly collect, store and interpret the logs in accordance with Article 12.
source_quote: where relevant, a description of the mechanisms included within the high-risk AI system that allows deployers to properly collect, store and interpret the logs in accordance with Article 12
